name: studio-ide-tests
description: Suite de QA automatizada de Studio IDE (no forma parte de la app publicada).

scripts.test:unit: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files = readdirSync('.').filter((f) => f.endsWith('.test.js') && f !== 'lint.test.js').sort(); const res = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--expose-gc', '--test', '--test-reporter=spec', ...files], { stdio: 'inherit' }); process.exit(res.status ?? 1);"
